reading: Deterministic on identical input, so a fixed row order is enough to make it repeatable.

Shuffling does not change the group count, so order-dependence is not the mechanism and the difference against the training record has another cause. Look next at whether the atlas rows themselves changed, or the clustering code did.
2210 of 2274 sequences share a length with at least one other, which is the population that an unstable sort can reorder.
